text:
liza: seeing a surge of apiserver 502/503s in eu-central-1 since ~11:00 UTC. controller-manager workqueue growing and many gpu-onboard jobs stuck at Attach. NVMe iowait on control-plane hosts is high.
infra-bot: [ALERT] apiserver error rate 6.8% (eu-central-1)  etcd iowait high  controller-manager queue +86 
jin: confirming, dumping quick state: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system get pods | egrep 'kube-apiserver|kube-controller-manager'
kube-apiserver-eu-central1-1   Running   (restarts: 3)
kube-controller-manager-0       Running   (queue-depth: 86)
```
oliver: provisioner logs show repeated attach latency/timeouts:
```
2026-03-21T11:02:11Z attacher: error attach: timeout waiting for device, i/o delayed
2026-03-21T11:02:18Z provisioner: enqueue gpu-onboard job id=... state=retry backoff=6s
```
aya: ran a quick fio trace on one control-plane host after the spike: observed tail latencies ~220-480ms and nvme retry counters incrementing. also saw increased firmware retry hints in kernel logs (nvme_core).
liza: couple mitigations I want to try now: 1) delay compaction/defrag window for 30m; 2) temporarily route new onboarding to eu-west1 fallback pool; 3) increase attach timeout and enable 3 pre-warmed GPU nodes in eu-central1 (spot -> on-demand fallback). cost tradeoff noted.
jin: agree on routing. on compaction: prefer to throttle frequency not full disable so snapshots don't pile up. we can flip schedule to a later off-peak time.
oliver: patch ready to change compaction schedule in configmap:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch cm etcd-maintenance --patch '{"data":{"compaction-schedule":"0 4 * * *"}}'
```
aya: applied patch and restarted etcd-maintenance job. running a small validation: apiserver 503 rate down from 6.8% -> 2.1% within 6m, controller-manager queue from 86 -> 30. attach timeouts still occasional but less frequent.
storage-bot: storage infra notes: NVMe controllers show elevated command retries and a firmware-level background GC kicked in concurrent with the compaction + snapshot purge. we've opened ticket INF-4301 and will supply telemetry and SMART logs there. possible firmware GC + host-level defrag overlap.
infra-bot: [INFO] compaction schedule adjusted at 11:10 UTC by jin
liza: scheduling prewarm: oliver, please spin up 3 spot prewarmed GPU hosts in eu-central1 and set auto-convert to on-demand at +20m if backlog > 20. estimate ~$90/hr.
oliver: spinning up spot prewarm now. added autoscaler flag: --prewarm-threshold=20 --prewarm-convert-mins=20.
jin: small follow-up: add a compaction guard in control plane that checks cluster i/o (iops/iowait) and onboarding backlog before allowing defrag/compact to run. low effort and prevents overlap. I'll own a quick PR.
aya: storage infra will throttle firmware GC if retries remain high; RMA may be considered for failing devices if SMART degrades. putting telemetry attachment in INF-4301.
infra-bot: [RESOLVED] apiserver error rate returned to baseline at 11:20 UTC
liza: action items recap: INF-4301 (storage telemetry) assigned to aya; compaction-guard PR assigned to jin; prewarm/autoscaler flags owned by oliver; finance notified of incident budget for spot->on-demand conversion. closing for now, will keep INF-4301 open for RCA and follow-ups.
